title: TrendRush
description:
Create YouTube Shorts for a general English-speaking audience.

The channel covers highly interesting and trending topics from different categories, including unusual facts, strange discoveries, technology, internet trends, mysteries, surprising events, science, history, space, animals, and viral stories.

Every video must have a powerful hook in the first 1–2 seconds that immediately creates curiosity.

Keep the video fast-paced, engaging, and easy to understand. Avoid boring introductions and unnecessary explanations.

Use natural American English.

Build the story so that each sentence makes the viewer want to hear the next one. End with a memorable fact, twist, surprising conclusion, or curiosity that encourages viewers to comment or watch another video.

Do not invent facts. Use accurate information whenever possible.

The final result should feel like a professionally produced viral YouTube Short, not like a generic AI video.
remark: Use this prompt to create engaging viral YouTube Shorts for the TrendRush channel.
